purpose: The places the legacy listings actually used, resolved against the official registers, with every name the legacy data spelled them by, so place search and ambiguity resolution start from reviewed identities rather than free text.

decision.scope: approximate point coordinates for Bulgarian settlements
decision.reason: No checked official source both identifies EKATTE settlements and supplies a point or geometry for each settlement.

sources_checked.reason: The official settlement register contains EKATTE and administrative metadata, but no latitude, longitude, point, or geometry field.
These are regional labels, not settlement records, and have no EKATTE identifier for a safe settlement join.

prohibited_inferences: Do not assign a NUTS label point or regional centroid to a settlement.
Do not infer coordinates from a settlement name, municipality, district, or elevation category.
Do not expose viewport, radius, or draw-on-map search until a source with settlement-level geometry and reviewed provenance is approved.

official_registers.note: The full BG + GR register (26,775 areas, 9.4 MB) is not copied here. It is a reference dataset, not a legacy fact, and it is reproducible from the official sources below. It stays available at production/data/geography-registry.json under git tag legacy-app-final.

authorities.authority: National Statistical Institute of the Republic of Bulgaria
authorities.use: Authoritative Bulgarian administrative names and identifiers. Capture the source revision on every import.
Authoritative Greek register for imported municipality and settlement records.
Stable cross-border regional identifiers. NUTS is statistical geography, not a replacement for national property-address validation.
Map boundary source for NUTS-level browse surfaces. Keep geometry version and CRS with each imported boundary.
Greek administrative/census-map import source. These maps are census geography and must not be represented as legal cadastral boundaries.
Telephone number-area codes only; never infer a listing address from a code.
Telephone number-area codes only; never infer a listing address from a code.
Validate or enrich a submitted Greek address through the official lookup; do not derive a property location solely from a postcode.
Official 2021 census hierarchy and settlement names, published to settlement level on 29 March 2024.

known_gaps: No settlement coordinates exist. No checked official source supplies a point per EKATTE settlement, so map, radius and viewport search cannot be built on legacy data.
Neighborhood is not a register level. Only one legacy place carries a raw locality label (Дербере, in Sandanski municipality), and it is not a register entry.
Greek places resolve to ELSTAT identifiers with area-only precision; they carry no EKATTE and no municipality code.
Aliases are the strings the legacy data actually used plus the official native and transliterated names. No transliteration was generated here.
Legacy site copy described the agency's coverage as Sandanski, Pirin and the Black Sea coast as separate areas. That coverage claim is unconfirmed and is recorded in content.json, not here.
